name: agent-forge
description: Codex workflow plugin for adaptive, low-intrusion planning and agent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Codex work with explicit process controls.
interface.longDescription: Agent Forge provides Codex-compatible workflow assets for adaptive planning and lightweight agent orchestration. Its current RalPlan skill turns ambiguous software or workflow requests into approved local Markdown execution plans with controls for task scale, clarification depth, and research-backed read-only subagent exploration.
